column1: # The verdicts of HL7's FHIR Validator over the documents FerroFED's tests
# write (FERROFED_EMIT_DIR), each against the MyHealth@EU build of its
# guide: the Patient of every document against MyHealth@EU Core 1.0.1, each
# laboratory report against Laboratory Report 9.2.0, each discharge report
# against Hospital Discharge Report 9.2.0 (#1952), each vaccination history
# against Vaccination 10.0.0-preview (#1980), each patient summary against
# Patient Summary 1.0.0-poc, each prescription the map mode writes against
# ePrescription and eDispensation 1.0.0-poc, and each imaging report
# against Medical Imaging Report 9.1.1 (#2041). The gateway writes no
# dispensation: a received one reaches its member byte for byte. The
# a run's verdicts differ from the first three columns, so a change is
# recorded on purpose, and scripts/conformance/myhealth-eu.sh counts them on
# the README badges. The cause of an invalid verdict is the issue that holds
# it: #2039 for a summary whose allergy code carries no coding from the
# required eHDSIAllergenWithExceptions value set, and the upstream report on
# #212 for the imaging guide, whose closure names hl7.fhir.eu.base
# 2.0.0-gamma, which no registry publishes. FerroFED's own test run, no
